title: Wages and technology demand cushion the energy shock
工资与科技需求缓冲能源冲击
read: The Bank of Japan expects higher energy costs to weigh on activity in fiscal 2026. Wage gains, government support and AI demand provide offsets; easing energy pressure and stronger income-to-spending transmission underpin its later pickup.
日本央行预计能源成本上升拖累2026财年经济。工资增长、政府支持与AI需求提供缓冲；能源压力缓解、收入更有效地转化为支出，构成后续增长改善的基础。
driver: Energy imports reduce purchasing power when prices rise faster than household income. The Bank of Japan sees wage gains and fiscal measures cushioning that pressure.
能源价格涨幅超过家庭收入时，进口能源会削弱购买力。日本央行认为工资增长与财政措施有助于缓冲压力。
upside: If energy costs ease while wage gains hold, real incomes and household spending could improve; broader demand would support domestic-facing earnings.
若能源成本下降且工资增长持续，实际收入与家庭支出可能改善，更广泛的需求将支持内需型企业利润。
downside: If energy and import costs stay high, they could absorb wage gains and constrain consumption even with strong technology demand.
若能源与进口成本持续偏高，可能抵消工资增长并限制消费，即使科技需求仍强。
watch: Real wages, household spending, energy import costs and the next Bank of Japan outlook.
实际工资、家庭支出、能源进口成本与下一份日本央行展望。

title: Export strength meets higher rates
出口强劲，政策利率上升
read: The Bank of Korea describes support from exports, investment and recovering consumption. Inflation and housing-related credit pressures keep further rate increases in view.
韩国央行指出出口、投资与消费复苏支持经济。通胀与住房相关信贷压力，使进一步加息仍在考虑范围内。
driver: Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.
央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。
upside: If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.
若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。
downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.
若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。
watch: Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.
出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。

title: Earlier rate rises are still working through spending
此前加息仍在传导至支出
read: The RBA expects earlier interest-rate increases to slow spending, with their full effect still ahead. Its August outlook places inflation’s return to the midpoint of its target range in early 2028 and anticipates a gradual rise in unemployment.
澳大利亚央行预计此前加息将减缓支出，其完整影响尚未显现。8月展望预计通胀于2028年初回到目标区间中点，失业率则逐步上升。
driver: Rate increases can reduce household spending capacity and investment demand. The RBA expects slowing demand to help reduce inflation.
加息可能压低家庭支出能力与投资需求。澳大利亚央行预计需求放缓将有助于通胀回落。
upside: If inflation falls with only a modest slowdown in employment and spending, households could regain purchasing power without a sharp contraction.
若通胀回落，同时就业与支出仅温和放缓，家庭购买力可能恢复，而无需经历剧烈收缩。
downside: If higher borrowing costs weaken spending more than expected while energy inflation persists, growth could slow before households receive price relief.
若借贷成本上升对支出的打击超出预期，而能源通胀持续，经济可能在家庭获得价格缓解之前先行放缓。
watch: Household spending, unemployment, housing activity and inflation’s response to earlier rate increases.
家庭支出、失业率、住房活动与通胀对先前加息的反应。

title: A firmer outlook still depends on energy relief
前景改善仍取决于能源压力缓解
read: The ECB’s September assessment finds the economy more resilient than expected. Its baseline relies on the energy shock fading, real incomes recovering and infrastructure and defence spending supporting demand; persistent export competitiveness problems remain a constraint.
欧洲央行9月研判认为经济韧性强于预期。其基准情景依赖能源冲击消退、实际收入恢复，以及基建与国防支出支持需求；出口竞争力问题仍构成限制。
theme: Energy, real incomes and public investment
能源、实际收入与公共投资
driver: Lower energy inflation can restore household purchasing power, while infrastructure and defence spending support investment. Those are assumptions behind the ECB’s improving growth path.
能源通胀下降可能恢复家庭购买力，基建与国防支出则支持投资。这些构成欧洲央行增长路径改善的前提。
upside: If energy pressure eases as assumed and public investment reaches activity, domestic demand could carry more of the growth pickup.
若能源压力按预期缓解，公共投资转化为实际活动，内需可能为增长改善提供更多动力。
downside: If the energy shock persists, real-income gains could be delayed while higher input costs pressure margins and slow the projected pickup.
若能源冲击持续，实际收入改善可能推迟，投入成本上升则可能压缩利润率、拖慢预期中的增长改善。
watch: Energy prices, real household incomes, investment spending and bank lending.
能源价格、家庭实际收入、投资支出与银行信贷。
